# Hotspots — churn-ranked

<!-- story: e06s03 -->
**Generated by** `bash scripts/churn-rank.sh 0 --write` over `HEAD`.
Churn is the number of commits touching the file; `lines` is its current size;
`tests` is how many test files name it. Review pays where churn and size meet.

high-churn, low-test file is where the next regression goes unnoticed.
